summary: Umbrella raised from a live clean Windows 11 reproduction. See brief.md for the captured app.log evidence and the portable-relayout blast-radius report.

Fix D SHIPPED: Windows standard-Electron relayout. CubricVision.exe at the zip root, app tree at resources/app, start.vbs and start-with-terminal.bat deleted. Three blockers the D report missed were found and fixed: no launcher means no launcher env (main.js derives the roots), Windows cannot overwrite a running exe (applier renames aside), and applyDelta could not express a retired root (RETIRED_PATHS). Fix E release note written. Card stays doing: F1, F2 and F3 remain.

Fix D and E committed bbfd6295. validation.md added: what D proved (staged layout, delta deletes, bare-exe root resolution, tests) vs what it did not (full boot blocked by port 3000, SAC machine, transition update, second update). Card stays doing for F1/F2/F3.

Fix D open validation gap 1 CLOSED, user-verified. Staged a win32 build to C:/tmp/mpi387-boot with --clean --no-archive --no-source-manifest and launched CubricVision.exe by its own path with NO environment set. The window rendered the real UI (no white box) and came up on the engine-install screen. Decisive extra evidence the log alone could not give: the Models-folder field pre-filled with the staged portable root, so getDefaultModelsRoot resolved inside the portable folder without any launcher env - the exact no-launcher fallback the D report flagged as unproven. Server booted on 127.0.0.1:3000 from resources/app, all four portable roots logged inside the staged folder, staged app.log had zero ERROR and zero WARN, and the build left the tracked tree clean. Gaps 2-4 (SAC machine, transition update, second update) all need a real release first. F1/F2/F3 still open, so the card stays doing.

F1 FIXED, and it was bigger than the brief said. Root cause: a targetPath weight resolves UNDER the node folder and downloads first (RIFE writes comfyui-frame-interpolation/ckpts/rife/rife47.pth), leaving a folder of subdirs only. MPI-243 already had the right test (a real node ships top-level FILES) but applied it ONLY to the extraction site. Four places still read install state off bare pathExists/isCompleteOnDisk on that folder: startModelDownload (the logged illegal complete-to-downloading, cosmetic), startUniversalWorkflowInstall, comfy _localModelsCheck (UI reports the node installed), and shared checkUniversalWorkflowDepsStatus - that last one is NOT cosmetic, a commit-pinned node is rescued by the drift ladder but an UNPINNED node is silently never installed. Predicate moved to downloadCompletion.js as isNodeInstalledOnDisk plus isDepInstalledOnDisk for the type branch; downloadManager _nodeFolderHasFiles is now an alias so extraction and install-state cannot drift apart. Remote twin deliberately untouched - it trusts the wrapper volume scan, never local disk. Two new cases in download-completion.test.cjs, full suite 275/275 zero failures, eslint clean on all five files. NOT proven end-to-end: no real RIFE install was run.

F2 and F3 closed, so all six MPI-387 defects are now resolved in code. F2: user decided to keep the CUDA build (no CPU-only archive exists to ship) but kill the silence - the else branch in platformEngine resolveDownloadConfig now WARNs that the NVIDIA build is a deliberate fallback and the download is larger than the machine needs, and records that detectIntelArcGPU matches Arc/Data-Center only so Iris/UHD/HD fall through BY DESIGN. F3: no code change is the correct outcome - Frame-Interpolation install.py fails to build cupy-wheel (pkg_resources gone in setuptools 83) then exits 0, so the node lies about its own status while runCustomCommand checks the exit code correctly. cupy only accelerates the CUDA path and RIFE falls back to torch, so nothing is broken. Documented as expected noise on the dep entry in nodesDeps.js with a warning not to weaken the exit-code check or pin cupy. Flagged but deliberately NOT fixed: that dep entry carries the wrong user-facing name (ComfyUI Impact Subpack, copy-pasted from the entry below). Suite still 275/275, eslint clean. Remaining MPI-387 validation is release-time only: a real SAC machine, a transition update, a second update, and no real RIFE install has exercised F1 end to end.

Card set to maturity validating (stays doing, already top of the column). All six defects A-F are resolved in code, so what is left is validation, not implementation. Maintainer has the reproducing Windows 11 laptop with Smart App Control ON in hand, which makes all THREE unmet acceptance items testable on that single machine once a full Windows zip exists: A (deepest path under 260 from a default Explorer Extract All into Downloads), B (Impact-Pack pip with git absent from PATH) and D (CubricVision.exe launching under SAC - expect a SmartScreen More info / Run anyway, not a silent block). Only the two update-path items then remain, and both need a real release to exist first.

Validation GATED ON THE 1.3.0 RELEASE by user decision. A throwaway master build (hash 2ee5ee1581a7) was made and confirmed rootless, but the user chose not to test on the reproducing laptop with it - a concurrent session is still landing work and the evidence should come from the artifact users actually receive. This is a better gate, not just a delay: the 1.3.0 bundle also makes D gap 3 reachable for the first time, a real v1.2.0 install applying the update with the users OLD applier. One artifact plus one app.log settles A, B, C, D-SAC, D-transition, F1, F2 and F3 on the Smart App Control laptop. The ONLY item 1.3.0 still cannot reach is gap 4, a SECOND update applied from the new layout, which exercises loadExtractZip resources/app branch and evictBusyFile and needs 1.3.1 or later. That is the last thing standing between this card and done.

CLOSED. A/B/D/E/F1/F2/F3 all settled on the reporting hardware (see validation.md). The last item ran 2026-08-01 and FAILED: the in-app fetch+spawn on the 1.2.0-era path. Fetch half passed live for the first time (current=1.2.0 latest=1.3.0, 451,116,582 bytes byte-exact); apply half did nothing. Root cause proven with three runs - main.js spawns detached with stdio ignore, giving the child a NUL stdout, so update.bat shell-redirect capture is always 0 bytes and update-from-zip.bat always gets an empty argument. Controls: same spawn with a 6 KB download also 0 bytes (size innocent); identical command under a normal cmd /c console captured 170 bytes exit 0 (command innocent). Legacy code on the user disk, unfixable by shipping; master already replaced it with win-update.cjs which is immune by construction. Mitigation: Windows update bundle deleted from v1.3.0 (macOS/Linux kept), release notes corrected, trap recorded in docs/releases/portable-distribution-contract.md. Windows deltas resume at 1.4.0. Fix C never exercised and deliberately accepted as unit-tested only. Residuals to MPI-422.
